title: Plan Uplift by Personal Account Plan — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Line Sheet
content:
For the credit given on filing on an incorrect-amount dispute of a Pocketwire Visa Debit Card single-use virtual card purchase, the plan uplift follows the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account.

| Linked Pocketwire Personal Account plan | Plan uplift |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Summit | 6.00 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 6.00 |
| Pocketwire Prime | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Plus | 3.00 |
| Pocketwire Core | 0.00 |
| Pocketwire Lite | 0.00 |

The plan is the one shown on the linked personal account's record. The card's own tier does not decide the plan uplift. For example, a Pocketwire Visa Platinum Debit card linked to a Pocketwire Onyx account takes the Onyx line, 6.00.
